full_judgment: 2. The petitioner No. 1 herein as plaintiff instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 74 of 1994 for declaration of title and for further declaration that registered kabala being No.6996 dated 02.07.1991 executed by tile defendant nos. 1 and 2 in favour of defendant No. 3 was collusive, void and not binding upon the plaintiff' and also for recovery of khas possession by evicting the defendants therefrom. The suit was decreed on compromise with defendant No. 1 and 2 and ex-pare against the rest by judgment and decree dated 02.09.2002. Then, the defendant Nos. 4 to 6 made an application under order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure being Miscellaneous Case No. 23 of 2006 for restoration of the suit to its original file and number after set-ting aside the experte decree.
